note: The size of the EDITOR bundle, gzipped. The viewer crate builds twice (docs/viewer.md section 2): the reader bundle, whose bars are in bundle-size.json, and this one, the same crate with `--features editor`, served at /ui/editor and carrying every reader screen plus the authoring screens. The two numbers do the same two jobs they do for the reader (docs/viewer.md section 13): max_gzip_bytes is the CEILING, derived from arithmetic rather than from today's build, and max_growth_gzip_bytes is the PER-CHANGE BUDGET that scripts/checks/bundle-size.sh --base measures against the measured_gzip_bytes recorded on the merge base. Nothing here may raise the reader's ceiling, and a reader who never opens /ui/editor downloads none of these bytes.

bars.claim: the finished editor bundle is the reader bundle plus one authoring screen for each resource type the server writes
